content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-explained-digital-2|How Creators]] in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for payments, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-payment-every-detail-11|automated]] delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-15. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-6|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] is designed to be independent of restrictive platforms, allowing creators to sell their ebooks and receive payments without intermediaries. This approach ensures that creators maintain ownership of their sales data and customer relationships, giving them the freedom to operate their businesses as they see fit. By leveraging tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, creators can build a robust and reliable sales pipeline that is not dependent on third-party platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign commerce infrastructure, you'll need to gather a few essential components. This includes a domain name, a GitHub or Cloudflare account, and a NOWPayments API key. You'll also need to prepare your ebook files and set up a system for delivering them to customers. With these elements in place, you can begin building your sales pipeline and start receiving payments in Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline involves integrating NOWPayments with your sales page and configuring your ebook delivery system. This can be done using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which allow you to automate the delivery process and ensure that customers receive their ebooks instantly after payment. By using a sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can ensure that your sales pipeline is secure, reliable, and resistant to censorship or interference from third-party platforms.
Build a sovereign commerce infrastructure today.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your sales pipeline is set up, you can go live and start processing transactions. This involves testing your payment and delivery system to ensure that it's working correctly and making any necessary adjustments. With NOWPayments, you can receive payments in Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, and automatically deliver ebooks to customers using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This streamlined process ensures that you can focus on selling your ebooks and growing your business, rather than worrying about payment processing or delivery logistics.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your ebook sales grow, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to meet increasing demand. This can be done by upgrading your Cloudflare or GitHub plan, or by adding more advanced automation tools to your sales pipeline. With a sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can scale your business without being limited by restrictive platforms or intermediaries, giving you the freedom to grow and expand your operations as needed. By leveraging the right tools and technologies, you can build a robust and reliable sales pipeline that supports your long-term success as a digital creator.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Take control of your ebook sales and revenue.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Complete Builder Kit, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, offers a comprehensive solution for digital creators looking to establish a sovereign commerce infrastructure. This kit provides the tools and resources needed to build a reliable and scalable sales pipeline, and is priced at $197.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: set up a domain name and GitHub or Cloudflare account, prepare your ebook files and delivery system, integrate NOWPayments with your sales page, configure your ebook delivery system using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, test your payment and delivery system, and go live. With these steps, you can establish a reliable and scalable sales pipeline that puts you in control of your ebook sales and revenue.
